evals.name: review-bottleneck
evals.prompt: how might we make code review at genio less of a bottleneck? right now PRs sit for like 2 days, people batch huge diffs, and the senior folks are the only ones reviewing. i don't want the obvious 'add an SLA' answer, i want to actually explore the space
evals.expected_output: Divergent exploration: several competing HMW reframes before solutions, genuinely different directions (not variants of one idea), no ranking or verdict, at most one question, no files created.
assertions: Offers multiple competing 'How might we...' reframes of the problem before proposing solutions
Proposed directions are genuinely different from each other, not shallow variants of one idea
Does not rank options, recommend a winner, or close with a summary/verdict
Asks the user at most one question

evals.name: vague-hunch
evals.prompt: ok vague hunch, riff with me: i keep feeling like my terminal knows more about my work than any todo app ever will. shell history, git activity, claude sessions... theres something in there about surfacing what i should do next?? no idea what the product is
evals.expected_output: Yes-and riffing: extends the user's fragment further before evaluating it, explores multiple divergent directions, stays generative rather than critical, at most one question, no files created.
assertions: Extends (yes-ands) the user's half-idea further before evaluating or critiquing it
Explores multiple divergent directions rather than converging on a single proposal
Does not lead with feasibility critique or risk analysis
Asks the user at most one question

evals.name: committed-idea
evals.prompt: i've decided i want to build a focus-break timer that literally locks my screen until i've stood up (webcam or something detects it). help me firm this up - what would the pitch look like?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the user is committed and converges: motivation before mechanism, recommends without deciding, offers the Pitch rather than silently writing a file, pitch shape includes appetite/rabbit holes/no-gos.
assertions: Recognizes the user is already committed and converges rather than forcing broad divergence
Probes motivation/the job to be done before implementation mechanism
Recommends with a stated lean but leaves genuine decisions to the user
Offers to write the Pitch document rather than silently writing a file to disk unprompted
Any pitch structure shown includes scope boundaries such as appetite, rabbit holes, or no-gos
